summary: Bug Categories feature (iter265) backend tested end-to-end via pytest. Verified OTP auth returns 'token' for customer/partner/admin, create saves category for all 5 valid values (payment, booking, login, account, other), invalid/missing/null category falls back to 'other', uppercase normalized to lowercase, partner can create with category, GET /bugs/my includes category, admin list returns category_counts with all 6 required keys and filtering by category=payment/login works, invalid/empty category filter returns all, existing status/role/q/pagination filters still work, and admin resolve+reopen preserve the category. 26/26 tests passed.
critical_code_review_comments: bug_controller.admin_list: category_counts does cat_counts['other'] += legacy_other after summing per-category counts. This correctly rolls up legacy/invalid-category rows into 'other'. Fine.
BugCreate.category uses `str | None = None` and _norm_category gracefully handles None/invalid -> 'other'. Backward compatible.

Minor: _norm_category accepts non-string inputs implicitly only via truthy check — if a client sends category as a non-string (e.g. list) it will raise AttributeError on .strip. Low risk because pydantic constrains to str|None, but worth noting.
seed_data_creation: Each test prefixes titles with TEST_ and cleans up bug_reports via pymongo in module teardown fixture.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New test file /app/backend/tests/test_bug_categories_iter265.py covers all bug-category paths. The existing /app/backend/tests/test_bug_reports_iter264.py still covers prior behavior. Run with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=http://localhost:8001 pytest -o addopts='' <file>. The repo conftest requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env or frontend/.env; frontend/.env is absent in this env (frontend is Expo at /app/frontend). test_credentials.md is missing from /app/memory.
